title: skyBlip device configuration (v1)
description: JSON config exchanged over the dedicated GATT characteristic / USB-CDC. The producer (firmware) owns this schema; consumers pin a version. Every key here is read by the firmware: settings with no reader were removed rather than accepted and ignored (region, rotation, power_save, dropped after v1.0).

addr.description: 24-bit device address, auto-derived from chip id. A self-minted address (addr_table 0-4) is moved off the prefixes other trackers crowd; an issued one (5=ICAO, 6=FLARM, 7=OGN) is kept as issued

stealth.description: Transmit as an anonymous address table with the vertical rate marked unavailable (ADS-L G.1.9)

callsign.description: Printable ASCII. Shown on the status page and reported over the link; ADS-L carries no callsign field, so it is never transmitted on the air
